title: A chat started on a New Tab page has a working header: Terminal and Browser open their tab beside it, the app keeps answering, and [+] opens a New Tab page in a new column
preconditions: tagged bench build with the mock agent pane (CMUX_NEXT_AGENT_PANE_MOCK=1): its in-page daemon answers the chat in place of the script's `fake` ACP harness
a fresh launch: one window, one workspace, one terminal tab
converted from scripts/cmux-next/newtab-chat-header-e2e.py (cx-65br #19299, cx-p0fz), which stays for the real-harness run; tests/oracle/corpus/e2e/_scripts-094.json links them

expect.noReceiptReason: typed text and Return submit the New Tab page's own field; the key router names no action

steps.note: the page becomes that chat in its own tab (the script's page_chat)

expect.noReceiptReason: a native click on the page's header button; the terminal tab it opens is its result

steps.note: script row 'New Tab Page chat: header Terminal opens a terminal beside the chat'; with no pane param debug.agent_pane takes the focused pane's chat, else the one pane that shows an agent page, which is the chat until [+] adds a second

expect.noReceiptReason: a native click on the page's header button; the browser tab it opens is its result

steps.note: script row 'header Browser opens a browser beside the chat'

expect.noReceiptReason: a native click on the page's header button; the app answering and the terminal tab are its result

steps.note: cx-p0fz: with the browser's address bar editing beside the chat, the next header click restarted its edit in a loop and the main-thread watchdog stopped the app

expect.noReceiptReason: a native click on the page's header button; the page runs the open, and the new pane is its result

steps.note: script row 'header [+] opens a New Tab page in a new column' (cx-65br: the page's move into the column raced the store's tree); last, because its column page is a second agent page

invariants: agents at chat lists one chat session more than before start-chat, on the tab the New Tab page had: the chat started in place
each of terminal, browser and terminal-beside-browser adds one tab of its kind outside the chat's pane
column has one pane more than terminal-beside-browser's settled checkpoint, right of the chat's pane, showing a New Tab page; the chat's pane keeps only the chat
crashes at column shows no exit, and every step after terminal-beside-browser's click answered: the app kept running (cx-p0fz)
every mutation has one receipt or one typed error (I1)
ids stay stable unless the step created or closed them (I2)
teardown: quit the tagged app the run started
verify its debug socket is gone
untested: the real ACP harness path (harnesses/fake.toml in the build's acpmux home, the folder trust question): the oracle launch runs the mock agent pane, so the chat's daemon is the page's mock
the script's four repeated [+] rounds, each in a fresh workspace (a race that failed about half the clicks): the oracle's repeat and shuffle runs give the repeats
the [+] column's own chat and a plain New Agent Chat as the control
Hide tabs on the chat header
